paper.title_en: Local redundancies are necessary for long-lived memories in finite spatial dimensions
paper.abstract_en: We prove a no-go theorem for exponentially long-lived thermal memories, based on the structure of redundancies among Hamiltonian terms. For local stabilizer Hamiltonians in finite spatial dimensions, the absence of local redundancies---relations in which the product of a small number of Hamiltonian terms equals the identity---is known to preclude bulk thermodynamic phase transitions. Yet glassy dynamics can still sustain long-lived memories even without a thermodynamic transition, as demonstrated by LDPC codes on non-Euclidean graphs. A longstanding question, exemplified by Haah's cubic code, is whether such a mechanism can also support passive (quantum) memory in finite-dimensional Euclidean systems. We show that this route fails for local stabilizer Hamiltonians without local redundancies: at any constant nonzero temperature, local heat-bath dynamics is fast mixing, with $O(N)$ mixing time, where $N$ is the number of qubits. We establish this by proving a strong decay of correlations property of the thermal Gibbs state. We further prove rapid mixing with $O(\log N)$ mixing time under a stronger condition on induced redundancies in suitably chosen regions. This stronger result applies to several well-studied examples, including Haah's cubic code and its generalizations, as well as three-dimensional layer codes. Our work identifies redundancy structure as a key property for understanding thermal memories.

decision.reject_reason_zh: 该论文研究的是凝聚态量子信息背景下，有限维局域稳定子哈密顿量的热记忆与混合时间问题，不涉及引力、时空、联络、变分原理或修正引力理论。首阶段匹配仅为“热力学相变”的词语重叠，属于误匹配；与索引的引力/黑洞/PTA/全息主题相关性不足。
decision.title_zh: 有限空间维数下长寿记忆需要局域冗余
decision.abstract_zh: 我们基于哈密顿量各项之间冗余结构，证明了一个关于指数级长寿热记忆的不可行定理。对于有限空间维数下的局域稳定子哈密顿量，已知局域冗余的缺失——即少数哈密顿量项的乘积等于恒等式的这种关系不存在——会排除体热力学相变。然而，即使在无热力学相变的情况下，玻璃态动力学仍可维持长寿记忆，这已由非欧几里得图上的LDPC码所证明。一个长期存在的问题，以Haah立方码为例，是这种机制是否也能在有限维欧几里得系统中支持被动（量子）记忆。我们证明，对于无局域冗余的局域稳定子哈密顿量，这条路径是行不通的：在任意恒定的非零温度下，局域热浴动力学都是快速混合的，混合时间为$O(N)$，其中$N$是量子比特数。我们通过证明热吉布斯态的相关性具有强衰减性质来确立这一点。我们进一步证明，在适当选择的区域中关于诱导冗余的更强条件下，可实现混合时间为$O(\log N)$的快速混合。这一更强结果适用于若干被充分研究的例子，包括Haah立方码及其推广，以及三维层码。我们的工作将冗余结构确定为理解热记忆的关键性质。
